templates.why_chosen: High-confidence pipeline with 5 circled step markers and a dashed zoom callout that expands one stage into 3 sub-steps, rendered in an icon-illustrated style rather than plain boxes.
templates.what_to_learn: Circle-number every step in traversal order even across a callout boundary (1 outside, 2-4 inside, 5 outside); hang the callout as a dashed-border box off the stage it details, and use one colour per role (active vs passive) instead of a legend.

templates.why_chosen: An exploded-stage exemplar: the numbered main flow (execute_request to Raft Log to Standby Replicas) sends one dashed line to a grey callout box that unpacks steps 2-4, the AST conversion inside the active replica.
templates.what_to_learn: Keep the callout's numbering continuous with the main flow (steps 2-4 inside the box pick up right after step 1 outside it), and colour the one active replica differently (purple) from the passive ones (tan) it feeds so the reader can find the source of the zoom at a glance.
